[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Elliam Baniora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who specialized in [[Embryologist|embryology]]. He was considered by [[Mereel Skirata]], one of the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null]]-[[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARCS]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], to be the top man in the field.<ref name="o66" />
